n.story:
Your role is evolving from a general laborer to a specialized detailing technician and inventory manager. While automated tunnels and robotic arms take over the exterior washing of standard vehicles, your work shifts toward high-end interior restoration and the management of complex chemical inventories. AI tools now handle the tracking of supplies and the scheduling of fleet maintenance, freeing you from administrative headaches.

In this new landscape, you use augmented reality (AR) glasses that highlight missed spots or identify specific fabric types and the exact chemical pH required to treat them without damage. You are no longer just 'washing cars'; you are a guardian of vehicle longevity and hygiene, using AI to document the 'health' of a vehicle's interior and exterior surfaces for high-value clients and autonomous fleet operators.
amp: Precision chemical application for specialized fabrics
tools: Computer vision for surface damage detection
n.adv: Shift your focus toward high-end detailing and specialized surface treatments (like ceramic coatings) where human dexterity is irreplaceable, and embrace digital inventory tools to manage your business more efficiently.

n.story:
Your role remains grounded in the physical world, but your diagnostic capabilities are about to receive a massive upgrade. While robots still struggle with the manual dexterity required for improvised repairs or cleaning tight engine bays, AI will take over the 'detective work.' Instead of guessing why a vehicle is underperforming, you will use AI diagnostic tools that analyze sensor data and natural language descriptions from customers to pinpoint issues instantly.

As routine classifications and service scheduling become automated, your day-to-day work shifts toward high-value human interactions and complex problem-solving. You will spend more time explaining technical needs to clients—aided by AI visualizations—and ensuring that safety standards are meticulously followed. You are no longer just a maintainer; you are a precision technician who uses augmented reality and AI insights to perform delicate repairs with greater accuracy and speed.
auto: Identifying vehicle types and technical specifications

n.adv: Double down on your interpersonal skills and customer service. As diagnostics become automated, your ability to build trust and explain complex repairs to customers will be your greatest competitive advantage.
